card.name: The word whichever after a dose limit
card.fires_on: The word "whichever" right after a comma that closes an either-or limit on a dose or duration, as in "or 100 mg, whichever is smaller". A few stray hits occur on unrelated code or name pieces.

modes.label: Whichever after a limit
modes.description: "whichever" follows two alternative dose, time or amount limits and introduces "is less", "comes first" or similar.
modes.example: mg/kg of neostigmine methylsulfate or up to a total of 5 mg of neostigmine methylsulfate,<< whichever>> is less. 2.3 Dos

modes.label: Stray pieces
modes.description: Isolated hits on odd fragments such as code words or abbreviations inside a drug regimen.
modes.example: idine (300 mg Q<<ID>>) were coadministered for one

card.plain: It lights up on the word "whichever" that picks the lower or earlier of two dose or time limits.
